sources_actually_opened.title: Why Can You See the Moon During the Day? We Asked a NASA Scientist: Episode 19
sources_actually_opened.locator: 正文视频文字稿，第2段（Unlike our Sun开头）；网页提取L257–259
sources_actually_opened.supports: 月面反射太阳光；月亮在合适天空位置时，白天也能被辨认；满月在天空中与太阳相对。

sources_actually_opened.title: Moon Phases — NASA Science
sources_actually_opened.locator: 3 Quick Facts；New Moon；Daytime Moons；Overview From Space；网页提取L292–324、L332–339、L382–404
sources_actually_opened.supports: 月亮绕地球运动，月相、升落与太阳的相对位置有关；新月同太阳大致同升落，面向地球的一面未被阳光直接照亮，通常肉眼不可见；具体升落随季节、位置变化。

sources_actually_opened.title: Why Is the Sky Blue? — NASA Space Place
sources_actually_opened.locator: The Short Answer；正文关于大气散射的段落；网页提取L13–15、L36–46
sources_actually_opened.supports: 太阳光进入大气后被空气分子等散射，形成明亮的白天天空。
